title: Retry with Exponential Backoff
description: Retries transient failures with doubling delays plus jitter to avoid thundering herds. Recorded facts — Strategy: Retry with Exponential Backoff; Failure: transient errors; Tradeoff: slower recovery. Used by agent runtimes and microservices to stay useful when dependencies break.
demo:
# Retry with Exponential Backoff — runnable demo (python3)
# Retry with Exponential Backoff - backoff schedule (python3)
base=1
retries=5
max_wait=30
sched=[min(base*(2**i), max_wait) for i in range(retries)]
print("waits (s):", sched)
print("total worst-case wait: %ds" % sum(sched))
